items.title: Metal Sandbox: Isolated Execution and Command Scheduling for GPU Coding Agents on Apple Silicon
items.brief: 为 Apple Silicon 上的 GPU 编码智能体提供隔离执行与命令调度方案
items.summary: On-device inference requires kernels that make effective use of local accelerators. Efficient training and evaluation of models that generate Apple Metal kernels benefit from native macOS tools and concurrent agent sessions.
items.author: Haozhe Wang, Lina Chen, Fanqi Wan

items.title: LiveGeo: Benchmarking Geographic Agents in Continuously Evolving Worlds
items.summary: We introduce GeoWorld, a controllable and continuously evolving geographic environment platform for LLM agents, and LiveGeo, a benchmark for evaluating reliable decision-making in real-world geographic environments using GeoWorld.
items.author: Pengcheng Zhou, Xuanyu Liu, Yanchen Yin

items.title: Skill Adapter: Personalized Modification and Online Routing of General-Purpose Skills
items.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents use external skills to reuse task procedures and experience with tools. General-purpose skills describe shared execution procedures, while specific tool choices, operating practices, and output requirements vary across users.
items.author: Qijia Zhuang, Yanyi Gou, Wenbin Ma

items.title: S1-Evo: Experience-Guided Evidence Competition Attacks on Typed System-1 Decision Models
items.summary: Typed System-1 (S1) decision models are increasingly deployed in LLM agents for routing, moderation, and authorization to cut inference cost, yet untrusted context can still manipulate typed outputs and alter execution branches.
items.author: Kaixiang Wang, Junjie Li, Zhaojiacheng Zhou
